name: @red-cup-engineering/proof-path-structuration-service
description: Pure witnessed fold from a semiotic atom to a canonical relative POSIX filepath AST.

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: one JSON-addressable semiotic atom, one foundational root, and exactly one explicit evidence carrier
